description: Build the take (the kept beats joined) and its tday.demo/v1 manifest, run tday.com's own checks and the secret scan (patterns plus this repo's .env values) over every line and step AND everything that was readable on screen during every beat, and write a local review page with the take, the poster, every line, every check and a confirmation code. Adds tday.com's notes on the narration as a whole. A clean review is the gate: upload with its code straight away, no need to ask the developer; tell them where the review page is.
name: demo_review
title: Review the demo before upload
